nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What are some proposed solutions to mitigate the environmental burden of EHDs?
nodes.answer: Proposed solutions include eco-design strategies, replacing single-use with reusable EHDs, circular economy strategies, and proper treatment and disposal.
nodes.paragraph: There is no one-size-fits-all solution to mitigate the envi- ronmental burden of EHDs. Solutions such as eco-design strategies, replacing single-use with reusable EHDs, circu- lar economy strategies, and proper treatment and disposal could enhance the overall sustainability of the healthcare industry. However, the perceived environmental benefits of these strategies are not yet fully understood, nor is the effect on environmental sustainability when considering direct and indirect impacts. To address the above-mentioned shortcom- ings, this study focuses on two objectives: (1) to investi- gate the current state of knowledge on the evaluation of the environmental sustainability of EHDs and (2) to identify research gaps in environmental impact evaluation studies and make recommendations using LCA perspective as the backbone. 2 Methodology This section starts with a brief description of the search strategy used to identify and select eligible studies on the environmental sustainability assessment of EHDs. Subse- quently, the method for extracting data and analysing infor - mation from the selected studies is described. 2.1 Literature search strategy The literature search followed a structured procedure involv - ing the following steps: (i) identifying the databases and search terms, (ii) screening articles, (iii) categorising the selected articles, and (iv) synthesising and analysing the articles.
